messages:
deploy-bot: Pager: 2xx->5xx canary spike on /v1/generate detected at 5223344556. Alert: 5xx-rate > 5% for 3m. Auto-rollout protected.
chris (oncall): ACK - I'm joining. grabbing context and will triage.
maya: seeing memory pressure + increased tail latency on canary pool eu-canary-*-p. 502s and connection resets. no infra deploys in last hour.
chris (oncall): rolling feature flag down for canary to stop new traffic: `redwood flags toggle --name=canary_prefetch --env=canary --off`
deploy-bot: Feature flag `canary_prefetch` toggled off (eu-canary) by chris at 5223344604.
eve-op: good call. Suggest 50% traffic spin-down to be safe while we confirm root cause.
chris (oncall): initiating traffic split: `redwood traffic modify --target=eu-canary --pct=50` — will route remaining to stable.
maya: confirmed CPU drop on nodes and 502 rate halved within 30s. still seeing a small spike tied to commit abc123 in inference-runtime.
chris (oncall): bisect quick: reverted single commit abc123 with `git revert --no-edit abc123 && deploy quick --canary` — starting hotfix deploy.
deploy-bot: Hot patch deploy started: hotfix/abc123-revert -> canary at 5223344689.
deploy-bot: Hot patch deploy succeeded on canary at 5223344718.
maya: metrics: 5xxs back to baseline (~0.4%) and p95 latency normalized. Logs show error stack removed after revert.
support-liz: notifying affected customers now (email + status page). Message: "Interim issue with canary deployments caused elevated errors for a subset of requests. We've reverted the problematic commit and services are stable. No data loss." ETA for customer follow-up: 45m.
pm-jordan: product note: convincing this was a bad rollout of prefetch optimization. We'll gate the change behind stricter canary/telemetry next time.
chris (oncall): opening follow-up ticket: ENG-INC-7890 with postmortem checklist and rollback steps.
eve-op: leaving the traffic at 50% for 10m then gradually ramp to 100% if stable.
chris (oncall): 10m monitoring complete. ramping traffic back to stable. `redwood traffic modify --target=eu-canary --pct=100`
deploy-bot: Traffic update: eu-canary -> 100% at 5223344786.
chris (oncall): good recovery. marking incident as mitigated. will run full postmortem and schedule a canary policy review. :thumbsup:
support-liz: escalated customers updated on status page. closing customer-notify loop.
pm-jordan: thanks team — appreciate the quick revert and clear comms.
chris (oncall): incident closed for now. will keep watch 1h for regressions.
